0022600037.text: The Chicago Bulls host the Atlanta Hawks in the Bulls' 11th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Chicago is 1-9, 14th in the East and 4th in the Central, 6 games back, on an eight-game losing streak and 0-4 at home, while Atlanta is 7-5, 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East after a loss in its most recent game. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain and Tobe Awaka (both back) and Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), who are all out, and Caleb Wilson (hand) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), who are all out. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Chicago won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, most recently a 126-123 victory in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
